commands: gh pr diff 1622 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1622/run-local/diff.patch; wc -l .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1622/run-local/diff.patch; echo "==files=="; grep '^diff --git' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1622/run-local/diff.patch
echo "RUN_ID=[${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-}] ACTIONS=[${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}]"; echo "==BODY=="; gh pr view 1622 --json body --jq '.body'

echo "==exemption file references to init=="; grep -n "skills/init/SKILL.md" lib/test/reference-size-exemptions.json || echo "(none - good)"; echo "==changeset format=="; cat .changeset/trim-init-skill-prose.md 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "==spot-check run.sh pins=="; for p in "ensure-label.sh PRFlow" "no usable jq (missing or not executable)" "advisory project-memory check"; do printf '%s => ' "$p"; grep -c "$p" skills/init/SKILL.md; done

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
